text.tspan: Reference designators shown; component values are in power-supply-bom.md
(2) BUCK A U2 TPS54560-Q1 : VSYS -> 3.3 V (>=4 A, 2G-capable) -> 3V3_CELL
(3) BUCK B U3 LMR16006X : VSYS -> 3.3 V (~0.6 A) -> 3V3_SYS (comp + soft-start internal)
EN floats = ON. Optional R_enB 100k -> VSYS,
or a divider to set a custom UVLO.
Card is self-contained: on-card VBAT regulation, RF/BB decoupling + ferrite are INSIDE the module.
The raw-module VBAT star network (ferrite + MLCC arrays + 2x TVS) is NOT built on our board.
